description: This is the list type we use to sort the joblist in the sge scheduler.
The list will be build before the actual scheduling.
It is sorted by priorty ASC, submission time ASC, job number DESC.
Jobs in this list will then be scheduled one after the other.

attributes.name: priority
description: Normalized priority of the job/array task after applying all policies.
The job list is sorted by priority descending as primary sort criterion.

attributes.name: job_number
description: The job number. Third sort criterion.

attributes.name: job_name
description: @todo can be removed, it is only set, never read.

attributes.name: owner
description: @todo can be removed, it is only set, never read.

attributes.name: state
description: The state of an enrolled array task (JAT_state).
@todo can be removed, it is only set, never read.

attributes.name: master_queue
description: The master queue of an enrolled array task (JAT_master_queue).
@todo can be removed, it is only set, never read.

attributes.name: job_reference
description: Reference (Pointer) to the job in the scheduler's job list.

attributes.name: submission_time
description: The job submission time. Secondary sort criterion.
